story_spine: A device that turns a census score into brake pressure ends up easing over public housing and going blank where nobody was counted.
opening_object_or_event: A 3D-printed box clamped to the front fork of a docked Citi Bike, with a wire running down to the brake arm.
reader_initial_state: That someone built a small machine which decides how hard a public hire bike is to pedal.
crip_turn: Near the complexes the brake eased on a figure the survey had published and measured lower. Where the survey publishes no figure, the device shows no reading rather than a zero, and Blinder wrote that an absence of data is not an absence of pressure.
ending_move: The loose front-brake cables, found by hand on one bike in four, are the one thing the device turned up that no measure had a field for.

beats.happens: The device: where it sits on the bike, what it grips, and what a rider's legs feel.
beats.concrete_carrier: the box on the fork and the wire to the brake arm
beats.why_reader_wants_next: A box that decides how hard a bike is to pedal raises what it is deciding from.
beats.must_not_say_yet: anything about census data, neighbourhoods or what the resistance means

beats.happens: What it reads: satellite position, a card of block-group scores, a servo angle, and the measure those scores come from.
beats.concrete_carrier: the card of scores and the servo arm on the brake cable
beats.concept_introduced: rent burden: the share of a household's income that goes on rent and utilities, counted as a burden above thirty percent
beats.why_reader_wants_next: The threshold doing the work is a round number and the reader has not been told where it came from.
beats.must_not_say_yet: that the measure eases over public housing

beats.happens: Where the thirty percent came from.
beats.concrete_carrier: the figure itself, and the dates it changed
beats.why_reader_wants_next: A number with a legislative history is now pulling on a brake cable, and the reader has not yet been on a ride.

beats.happens: The ride around Prospect Park, and then the income and rent figures for where the brake bit hardest.
beats.concrete_carrier: Prospect Park West, then Windsor Terrace, then two rent figures five years apart
beats.why_reader_wants_next: The brake bit hardest in a neighbourhood with a six-figure median income, which is not where a reader would have put it.

beats.happens: Near public housing the resistance let go, and what the maker takes that to show.
beats.concrete_carrier: the bike speeding up alongside the complexes
beats.why_reader_wants_next: If the bike loosens where a subsidy is working, the reader wants to know what else the measure cannot separate.

beats.happens: What the measure does not hold, and the places where it holds nothing at all.
beats.concrete_carrier: a block group with no published figure
beats.why_reader_wants_next: A rider cannot feel the difference between a place under no pressure and a place nobody measured.

beats.happens: What the maker found with his hands while fitting the devices, and what he says the ride does not convey.
beats.concrete_carrier: the loose front-brake cables on one bike in four

definitions.rent burden: the share of a household's income that goes on rent and utilities
definitions.block group: the smallest area the survey publishes figures for

final_lens.lens_claim: An instrument that converts a published classification into force on the body can only transmit what has been published: where the survey publishes a figure it can ease or resist on it, and where the survey publishes none the honest output is not an easier ride but no reading at all.
final_lens.before_reading: A device that makes you feel the rent crisis in your legs.
final_lens.after_reading: A device that can turn a published rent-burden figure into resistance in the legs, and that shows no reading rather than a zero where the survey publishes no figure.
final_lens.crip_turn_carrier: the block group with no published figure

_carrier_repair_note: B6, B2 and final_lens.crip_turn_carrier reworded to pure noun phrases after CARRIER_INSTANCE_NOT_SUPPORTED. B6 and the crip turn carrier both lost the clause 'and the brake that therefore does not move', which was the architect asserting an occurrence inside a carrier: the ledger holds only what the device DOES when a block group has no published figure (F19, DISPOSITION), never a documented ride through one. facts_allowed, use_facts, cut_evidence, lens_claim, evidence_basis, Worth result and prohibitions are byte-identical to the held-out run; only carrier wording changed, and only where the validator forced it.
_turn_repair_note: REPAIR 2, architecture only. The declared turn asserted an EQUIVALENCE and a SUPERLATIVE the ledger does not license -- 'the easing ... and the unreadable block group are re-read as the same fact ... quietest where the pressure is least counted' -- fusing a LOW reading (F14, F15) with an ABSENT one (F19, F20). F19 says the device shows no reading RATHER THAN a zero and F20 calls flat ground a lie, so the ledger does not merely fail to support the fusion, it refuses it. crip_turn, final_lens.after_reading and final_lens.lens_claim were rewritten to the distinction the ledger does hold: a measured low value is not an absent one. Evidence, ledger, use_facts, cut_evidence, prohibitions, beats and Worth inputs are unchanged. OLD crip_turn, for the record: 'The easing over public housing and the unreadable block group are re-read as the same fact: the instrument can only pass on what the measure holds, so it is quietest where the pressure is least counted.'
_f10_split_note: use_facts and B3.facts_allowed re-point F10 -> F10a..F10e. Mechanical consequence of the ledger split; no beat, carrier, turn, lens, cut or prohibition changed.
